productionContext.units: simulation world units; frames are zero-based attack ticks, excluding charge/hitlag pauses

derivedContext.di: none; launch vector is authored before DI

conditions.selection: lowest contacting region index wins; body capsule intersection or shield intersection
conditions.rehit: one hit per attacker/attack serial/window; a higher window permits another hit
conditions.smashCharge: grounded held attack pauses before first active frame; endpoints exported
conditions.start: beginFighterAttack enforces grounding and canStartAttackStyle; motion fixture starts idle
conditions.landing: aerial landing cancels attack; no autocancel window represented

comparisonContext.timeOrigin: contact checkpoint, zero-based ticks; -1 means unobserved or unavailable
comparisonContext.grounding: smash/normal grounded; late neutral aerial at attack frame 20, z20, vz-2
comparisonContext.shield: full digital shield held before checkpoint, released afterwards; no powershield
comparisonContext.DI: neutral, no SDI or ASDI displacement
comparisonContext.actionable: canAttack for a normal action; not a universal earliest escape oracle
comparisonContext.optionPolicy: jab or forward tilt attempted at normal-ready + delay 0..12; optional approach only during delay; target otherwise neutral
limits: contact-state experiment, not complete approach safety
strictly earlier contact required; same-tick response is not certified
bounded true links exclude DI/SDI/escape-policy variation
no read or human reaction likelihood inferred

join: action family across distinct identities; never fighter equivalence
declaredMeaning: verbatim exported facts, including previously derived production measurements

referenceFieldMeanings.end: reported last active bound; gaps unknown
referenceFieldMeanings.total: reported action boundary; recovery not inferred
referenceFieldMeanings.percent: reported strongest rounded base damage; not multihit total

projection.damage: maximize shieldDamage on shield, percentDamage on body
projection.pairing: different production fighters; same category, spacing, percent, shielding; fixed Rifleman defender and shared fixture

tuningDecision: No supported parameter change: partial-order findings alone do not establish an unwanted trade-off or target.
